items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 40:1
items.html: The upper half of the Partzuf of Tvuna, that is, her Partzuf of GAR, is the Keter of Tvuna that she lacks. Thus this upper gate, which is called Keter, comprises fifty Sefirot. For so long as she lacks it and has only seven lower Sefirot, she has only forty-nine Sefirot, that is, seven times seven, which are forty-nine. But at the time when she attains that Keter, she will then have ten Sefirot, each of which is included of ten, and ten times ten are one hundred. It follows that the Partzuf of GAR that she lacks comprises fifty Sefirot. (Page 964, Item 17)
